flow.zh: -- 當時心境隨風去，如今拾來總是詩

en: Your expression, so still and silent
Delicate softness set against quiet plainness
Lush blossoms fall to the ground
The edge of the sky is near
Even a hand's breadth away is far
Purely a helplessness hard to resolve
A promise for some future day
It's just that I don't know when we'll meet again
What now shall become of it
Only folding tonight into the past
Dusk flowing over from across the street
At the turning corner of the years

points.zh: 馬德里位於西班牙中部，海抜670公尺，是歐洲地勢最高的首都。地處伊比利亞半島中心，南下可經直布羅陀海峽，與一水之隔的非洲大陸相通，北越比利牛斯山脉，直抵歐洲腹地。在歷史潮流中，因居戰略和文化交流位置而有“歐洲門戶”之稱。在馬德里，時時可以感受古代文明和現代文化的碰撞，處處散放著各族群交融的繽紛氛圍。如果爲馬德里附加一個標簽，可以是古典，也可以是時尚。有別於南部的文化之城巴塞隆納，馬德里的歷史古跡和現代建築紛繁并列，相交映輝，旣可擁抱中世紀和文藝復興時期的古香古色和蒼桑，又可徜徉於現代科技文明的璀燦風格。五月的午后，細雨初停，馬德里的黃昏分外美麗，每一條人行街道都浸潤著光影和寧靜，當夕陽爲馬德里的古典和時尚，披上金黃的色彩和流動的音符，徘徊其中就是一場夢的憧憬，是心靈的回歸和感動。
points.en: Madrid is located in central Spain, at an elevation of 670 meters, making it the highest-altitude capital in Europe. Situated at the center of the Iberian Peninsula, it connects southward via the Strait of Gibraltar to the African continent across a narrow strait, and northward over the Pyrenees to the heart of Europe. Owing to its strategic and culturally interconnected location throughout history, it has been called the "Gateway to Europe." In Madrid one can constantly feel the collision of ancient civilization and modern culture, and everywhere one senses the vibrant blending of different peoples. If one were to attach a single label to Madrid, it could be either "classical" or "fashionable." Unlike Barcelona, the cultural city to the south, Madrid's historic sites and modern architecture stand side by side in profusion, reflecting one another — one can embrace the antique charm and vicissitudes of the Middle Ages and Renaissance, while also wandering amid the dazzling style of modern technological civilization. On a May afternoon, just after a light rain has stopped, Madrid's dusk is especially beautiful — every pedestrian street is steeped in light, shadow, and quiet, and as the setting sun drapes Madrid's classical and fashionable sides alike in golden hues and flowing musical notes, wandering through it feels like a dream taking shape — a return and stirring of the soul.
